description: Run Shi publishes global one-kilometre household consumption-expenditure surfaces in purchasing-power-parity terms for every year from 2013 to 2024. Zenodo version two is public under CC BY 4.0 and lists annual GeoTIFFs for cell totals, per-capita values, population-filled variants and quality flags, plus country-year metadata. No directly related catalogue record was identified. These estimates can help locate household economic activity or stratify demand and service-access assumptions in spatial agent-based or infrastructure-capacity simulations. A caveat is that a gridded expenditure estimate is not a household survey for each cell, and PPP values are not local-currency spending or infrastructure demand by themselves. Filled-population variants and quality flags should be kept distinct from direct estimates. The own page lists a large multi-file archive, so combining years requires matching grid definitions and QA codes. I read the own Zenodo metadata and manifest without downloading rasters, validating national aggregates or checking each cell’s uncertainty.
